newsitem.title: USA: Manatee County, Fla., scraps gasoline tax hike.
newsitem.headline: Manatee County, Fla., scraps gasoline tax hike.

text.p: Florida's Manatee County has abandoned plans to seek a one-cent gasoline tax hike to finance stormwater improvements.
County Administrator Ernie Padgett recommended phasing in the stormwater upgrades over several years instead of seeking a tax hike for a major expansion.
He said the county could pay for the program via increases in revenues from its share of state gasolnine taxes plus increases in general revenues, utility funds and solid waste funds.

The tax hike was ommitted from the $260.3 million budget proposal Padgett submitted on Wednesday. The fiscal 1998 budget increases spending by $12 million over this year, while lowering property tax rates slightly.
The rate would decline to 8.5088 mills from 8.5224 mills in unincorporated parts of the county and to 7.7814 mills from 7.7950 mills in incorporated cities.
